This is a story from when I worked at a store that sold laptops and some other stuff. For privacy and safety, I will not state when or where this event occurred.

Context: This happened while I was finishing up my duties right before clocking off. I had to drop a few things on the other side of the store to my manager, so I had to walk through the encounter zone, where customers lurk. While walking down one of the main aisles, a few customers in the laptop section seized me with intent to solicit.

Foreign Guy: (stands in front of a laptop) Hey, we want to buy this laptop.
Me: Sure, let me just get my scanner out real quick. (takes inventory gun out and scans the barcode) Says we may have one. I’m gonna take a look.
I head for the cages near the laptops looking for the model. After a few minutes and a thorough search, no dice. I head back over to the customers.
Me: Sorry, guys. We don’t have anymore in stock.
FG: Okay, then we’ll take this one. (motions at the display model)
Me: Unfortunately, we cannot sell the display model. If you’d like, I can check to see if other stores have it in stock and even give them a call to put it on hold.
FG: Wait. Why can’t we buy this one?
Me: Because it’s not on clearance. We don’t sell the displays unless they’re on clearance.
FG: (condescendingly) Why do you have a display if you guys don’t have it?
Me: (beginning to grow aggravated due to being held up) Because we’re getting more in soon? We don’t sell displays if we’re getting more in stock because we sell them at discounted prices. If we sell the display, we’re going to need to put another one on display when we get it.
FG: That doesn’t make any sense.
Me: Not my problem.
Realizing I won’t budge, they motion me away after a few seconds. Immediately I turn around and walk away. The next few minutes consists of being stopped by other customers on my way out, however, fortunately, other customers were competent. While I’m helping the last set of customers, cutting through the aisle again, the foreign laptop customers called for me and gave me a hand motion.
Me: (under my breath) Fuck you. (audibly) Just a sec. I’m with another customer.

After those customers I was helping, I never got to see those guys again. Whether they found someone else or just left the store, I didn’t care. I finally got to go home.

TL;DR: Customers want a laptop. Out of stock. Unsatisfied with that answer, they shoo me away like a dog. When they need my help again, I shoo them away.
